nina (Finance): Heads-up: AcmeCorp Feb usage shows 980k embedding units billed but our consumer logs show ~485k. Opening a discrepancy ticket. Pls advise next steps.

leo (Billing Ops): can you dump the metering query & route? suspect dupes or late-arriving batched events.

nina (Finance): query: ```SELECT SUM(embedding_count) FROM metering.events WHERE customer_id='cust_acmecorp' AND date >= '2026-02-01' AND date <= '2026-02-28' AND route='/v1/embeddings'; -- 980123``` consumer: processed_embeddings_total=485212

tara (SRE): I looked at the ingest topic. There was a connector restart on 2026-02-20 that replayed ~450k messages due to an offset commit bug; replay caused duplicates in metering.events because we don't idempotent on kafka-offset. logs: "connector restart, last_committed_offset=...".

jordan (Acct Mgmt): Acme confirms they had no extra traffic. they're open to an adjustment.

leo (Billing Ops): plan: run dedupe by kafka_message_id/request_hash for cust_acmecorp in Feb, run dry-run to compute duplicated_units. If validated, we'll issue a negative line item credit and add a fix to connector to mark processed offsets and dedupe at write. Need finance approval to post credit.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-20260310 with job dedupe-acmecorp-dryrun. ETA 1h.

nina (Finance): provisional approve credit up to 500k units pending dry-run and CSV of duplicate ids. Please include reason "connector_replay_duplicates" in credit memo metadata.

leo (Billing Ops): ack. starting dry-run now, will post results and duplicate count back in this thread.
